reports.summaryZh: 库存与仓单下降，近月合约挤仓情绪为价格提供支撑。
reports.summaryEn: Falling stocks and warrants, alongside near-contract squeeze sentiment, supported prices.

reports.summaryZh: 月初淡季需求预期压制价格；下旬供给侧政策预期提振情绪。月度背景不解释每一旬的全部变化。
reports.summaryEn: Seasonal demand concerns weighed early in July; supply-policy expectations lifted sentiment late in the month. Monthly context does not explain every period move.

reports.summaryZh: 铝锭供应增加、季节性需求偏弱与累库形成压力；降息预期提供相反方向的支撑。
reports.summaryEn: More ingot supply, seasonal demand weakness and stock builds weighed against support from rate-cut expectations.

reports.summaryZh: 供应基本持稳，需求进入淡旺季切换，累库放缓；宏观预期反复，多空因素并存。
reports.summaryEn: Supply was broadly stable; demand approached a seasonal transition and stock accumulation slowed. Macro expectations remained mixed.

reports.summaryZh: 氧化铝供应过剩与库存增加压低投入品价格。此为成本端背景，不足以单独解释铝锭本旬上涨。
reports.summaryEn: Alumina oversupply and rising inventories weakened input prices. This cost context alone does not explain the period increase in ingot prices.

reports.summaryZh: 供应增幅有限，下游补库需求启动；汽车与新能源需求较强，房地产需求仍弱。
reports.summaryEn: Limited supply growth and downstream restocking provided support; automotive and new-energy demand contrasted with weak property demand.

reports.summaryZh: 价格回落与节前备货改善采购意愿，库存去化加快。快报偏强观点与本旬价格下跌并存。
reports.summaryEn: Lower prices and holiday stocking improved buying and accelerated destocking. The report’s supportive outlook coexisted with a falling period average.

reports.summaryZh: 宏观情绪与海外供应担忧支撑价格；高价抑制下游采购，国内库存小幅增加，基本面支撑较弱。
reports.summaryEn: Macro sentiment and overseas supply concerns supported prices, while high prices restrained buying and domestic stocks edged higher.

reports.summaryZh: 海外供给扰动、铜价联动与汽车及储能需求形成支撑；涨幅过快带来阶段性回调。
reports.summaryEn: Overseas supply disruptions, copper-linked sentiment and automotive/storage demand supported prices; rapid gains also prompted corrections.

reports.summaryZh: 降息预期与美元走弱提振金属；供应稳定，消费尚有韧性，但高价限制部分采购。
reports.summaryEn: Rate-cut expectations and a weaker dollar lifted metals; supply was stable and demand resilient, though high prices constrained some buying.

reports.summaryZh: 数据中心与储能需求、去库形成支撑；新增供给及淡季预期制约涨幅，宏观仍有不确定性。
reports.summaryEn: Data-center/storage demand and destocking provided support, while new supply, seasonal concerns and macro uncertainty limited upside.

reports.summaryZh: 政策及金属板块情绪支持价格；供给增加、订单偏弱与累库说明实体需求支撑有限。
reports.summaryEn: Policy and broader metals sentiment supported prices, while more supply, weak orders and stock builds pointed to limited physical-demand support.

historicalReports.titleZh: 华泰期货 · 铝市场报告
historicalReports.summaryZh: 春节前下游停工、需求转弱压制价格；低价补库与俄罗斯铝制裁消息又带来支撑，月内反复震荡。
historicalReports.summaryEn: Pre-holiday shutdowns weakened demand, while buying at lower prices and Russian-aluminum sanction headlines provided support, producing two-way price moves.

historicalReports.titleZh: 华泰期货 · 铝市场报告
historicalReports.summaryZh: 春节淡季下游开工疲弱、进口增加，价格承压；节后市场情绪回暖，铝价有所恢复。
historicalReports.summaryEn: Weak holiday-season activity and increased imports weighed on prices; improving sentiment after the holiday supported a recovery.

historicalReports.titleZh: 华泰期货 · 铝市场报告
historicalReports.summaryZh: 传统旺季需求逐步恢复、库存开始去化，带来价格支撑；云南复产与进口增加使供应端也在回升。
historicalReports.summaryEn: Seasonal demand recovery and the start of inventory drawdowns supported prices, while Yunnan restarts and imports also increased supply.

historicalReports.titleZh: 华泰期货 · 铝市场报告
historicalReports.summaryZh: 海外经济预期改善和英美限制俄罗斯金属交易推升市场情绪；国内进口增加、高价抑制采购，限制了跟涨力度。
historicalReports.summaryEn: Improved economic expectations and US/UK restrictions on Russian metals lifted sentiment; domestic imports and weaker buying at high prices limited the local advance.

historicalReports.titleZh: 华泰期货 · 铝市场报告
historicalReports.summaryZh: 市场情绪与氧化铝成本上升提供支撑，但高铝价抑制下游采购，后半月去库放缓、库存再度累积。
historicalReports.summaryEn: Market sentiment and higher alumina costs supported prices, but high aluminum prices discouraged downstream buying; drawdowns slowed and stocks rebuilt late in the month.

historicalReports.titleZh: 瑞达期货 · 铝市场报告
historicalReports.summaryZh: 云南、内蒙古项目持续复产，供应较充足；下游需求转淡、备货意愿不足，价格面临压力。
historicalReports.summaryEn: Restarts in Yunnan and Inner Mongolia kept supply ample, while softer demand and limited stocking interest weighed on prices.

historicalReports.titleZh: 华泰期货 · 铝市场报告
historicalReports.summaryZh: 云南停产产能恢复、四川部分复产增加供应；传统淡季订单和开工偏弱，海外衰退担忧也压制价格。
historicalReports.summaryEn: Yunnan capacity restoration and some Sichuan restarts increased supply. Weak seasonal orders and activity, together with overseas recession concerns, weighed on prices.

historicalReports.titleZh: 华泰期货 · 铝市场报告
historicalReports.summaryZh: 月初货源充足、接货意愿低迷；随后降息预期、国内政策与氧化铝成本上升带来支撑，价格回升。
historicalReports.summaryEn: Ample supply and weak buying weighed early in the month; rate-cut expectations, domestic policy support and rising alumina costs later helped prices recover.

historicalReports.titleZh: 华泰期货 · 铝市场报告
historicalReports.summaryZh: 需求改善带动库存快速下降；美国降息与国内降准、降息等政策改善情绪，铝价由低位回升。
historicalReports.summaryEn: Improving demand accelerated stock drawdowns; US rate cuts and domestic monetary easing improved sentiment, helping prices recover from early-month lows.

historicalReports.titleZh: 中信建投期货 · 铝市场报告
historicalReports.titleEn: CITIC Construction Investment Futures · Aluminum report
historicalReports.summaryZh: 氧化铝供应偏紧、价格上涨抬升生产成本，西北发运受阻也影响到货；高价同时抑制下游采购。
historicalReports.summaryEn: Tight alumina supply raised production costs, while northwestern shipping disruptions affected arrivals. High prices also restrained downstream buying.

historicalReports.titleZh: 瑞达期货 · 铝市场报告
historicalReports.summaryZh: 出口退税政策变化刺激短期抢出口、带动去库；临近政策节点，需求提振效应减弱，淡季与去库放缓带来压力。
historicalReports.summaryEn: Export-rebate changes encouraged short-term export front-loading and stock drawdowns. As the policy deadline approached, that boost weakened and seasonal demand softness added pressure.

historicalReports.titleZh: 华泰期货 · 铝市场报告
historicalReports.summaryZh: 季节性需求转弱、西北运输恢复增加到货；市场预期氧化铝成本将下行，铝价因此承压。
historicalReports.summaryEn: Seasonal demand weakened and restored northwestern transport increased arrivals. Expectations of lower alumina costs added downward pressure.

historicalReports.titleZh: 华泰期货 · 铝市场报告
historicalReports.coverageZh: 1月中旬春节专题 · 阶段背景
historicalReports.summaryZh: 春节期间下游加工企业停工，而冶炼端连续生产，可能带来季节性累库；海外关税政策仍存在不确定性。
historicalReports.summaryEn: Holiday shutdowns at downstream processors contrasted with continuous smelter production, creating seasonal stock-build risk; overseas tariff policy remained uncertain.

historicalReports.titleZh: 建信期货 · 铝市场报告
historicalReports.summaryZh: 关税变化加剧市场波动；氧化铝降价降低冶炼成本，供应小幅增加，市场同时期待旺季需求和去库。
historicalReports.summaryEn: Tariff changes increased volatility. Falling alumina prices reduced smelting costs and supply edged higher, while the market anticipated seasonal demand recovery and drawdowns.

historicalReports.titleZh: 建信期货 · 铝市场报告
historicalReports.summaryZh: 关税政策由通胀预期转为需求担忧，价格先涨后回落；国内政策支持与较早开始的去库提供缓冲。
historicalReports.summaryEn: Tariff policy shifted sentiment from inflation expectations to demand concerns, producing an advance followed by a retreat. Domestic policy support and early drawdowns cushioned prices.

historicalReports.titleZh: 建信期货 · 铝市场报告
historicalReports.summaryZh: 节前补库与下半月到货放缓带动超预期去库，低库存为价格提供支撑；这是库存端背景，不代表当月全部变动原因。
historicalReports.summaryEn: Pre-holiday replenishment and slower late-month arrivals produced stronger-than-expected drawdowns, supporting prices. This is inventory context rather than a complete explanation of the month.

historicalReports.titleZh: 华泰期货 · 铝市场报告
historicalReports.summaryZh: 关税窗口期抢出口维持加工需求，库存继续下降、现货供应趋紧；月底需关注淡季到来后需求能否持续。
historicalReports.summaryEn: Export front-loading sustained processing demand, while continued drawdowns tightened the spot market. Late-month reporting questioned how long that demand would last into the low season.
